cat /tmp/dashboard-dev.log"

/bin/bash -lc 'npm run dev -- --host --port 5173'
/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS -o /tmp/dashboard.html -D /tmp/dashboard.headers http://127.0.0.1:5174/ && cat /tmp/dashboard.headers && sed -n '1,30p' /tmp/dashboard.html"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -o -- \"--g-color[a-z-]*brand[a-z-]*\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | sort -u | head -20 && sed -i 's/var(--g-color-brand)/var(--g-color-base-brand-accent)/g' src/widgets.tsx && perl -0777 -i -pe 's/\\.dashboard-widget__handle \\{\\n  position: absolute;/.dashboard__grid:not(.dashboard__grid--edit) .react-resizable-handle {\\n  display: none;\\n}\\n\\n.dashboard-widget__handle {\\n  position: absolute;/' src/dashboard.css

npx vitest run src/dashboard-utils.test.ts"

sed -i \"s/import { readLayouts } from '.\\/App';/import { readLayouts } from '.\\/dashboard-utils';/\" src/dashboard-utils.test.ts
rg -n \"import\" src/dashboard-utils.test.ts"

python3 - <<'PY'

p=Path('src/App.tsx')
s=p.read_text()

printf '\\n--- App imports and grid ---\\n'; sed -n '1,30p;115,145p' src/App.tsx
